review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares no definitions, structures or classes. It has only theorems about the Fredholm index of continuous families: local constancy, constancy on preconnected sets, constancy along paths, and constancy along affine segments. All of them reuse Mathlib's IsLocallyConstant, PreconnectedSpace, Path, Path.segment and IsRCLikeNormedField. Mathlib does have a Fredholm directory (Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Operator/Fredholm/Basic.lean and Open.lean). The Fredholm notions themselves come from the imported TauCeti.Analysis.Fredholm.SmallPerturbation, not from this file, so they are outside this review. I did not compare them with Mathlib's versions. This rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication, and I found no competing concept introduced here. The named wrappers (Path.index_eq, index_eq_of_segment) are useful specialisations and do not count as defects under the rubric.
